attributes.description: Distinct GCE instances emitting metrics in each time bucket, from the googlecloudmonitoringreceiver OTel pipeline. A stable line is healthy. Sudden drops mean instances stopped, crashed or were deleted; sudden rises mean autoscale-out or newly provisioned VMs.

query.esql:
TS metrics-googlecloudmonitoringreceiver.otel-default
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gce_instance"
| STATS `Running Instances` = COUNT_DISTINCT(resource.attributes.instance_id) BY `Time Bucket` = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT `Time Bucket` ASC

embeddableConfig.description: One hexagon per GCE instance, keyed on resource.attributes.instance_id and labelled with attributes.instance_name. Ordered worst first by the selected metric. Toggle Color by between CPU utilization and Memory; both support Min, Max, Avg and Last over the dashboard time range. Thresholds follow Google's recommended high-CPU guidance: green below 70%, amber 70-89%, red at or above 90%; pale blue means no data. CPU utilization is a fraction of reserved cores and can exceed 100% on shared-core (E2) and burst (T2D) machine types, so sustained red is the signal, not a single spike. Memory is hypervisor-side only: compute.googleapis.com/instance/memory/balloon/ram_used divided by ram_size, reported by the VirtIO balloon driver with no guest Ops Agent required. Identity note: instance names are not unique across the fleet (recreated VMs and GKE node churn reuse names), and the disk latency, queue depth and performance-status series carry no instance_name at all, so every drilldown filter is keyed on instance_id while the hexagon label stays human-readable. Hover for a sparkline of the selected metric with its last-vs-average delta. Click any hexagon to open the instance detail dashboard or its metrics in Discover.

attributes.description: Fleet-wide balloon-driver memory utilization over time, computed as total ram_used divided by total ram_size per bucket. This is the hypervisor view of guest memory; filesystem usage and in-guest process memory are not visible. A stable band is healthy. A sustained climb toward 100%, especially alongside rising swap, means memory is overcommitted and instances may need resizing.

query.esql:

| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gce_instance"
| STATS ram_used = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(`compute.googleapis.com/instance/memory/balloon/ram_used`)), ram_size = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(`compute.googleapis.com/instance/memory/balloon/ram_size`)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL memory_used_pct = 100.0 * ram_used / ram_size
| KEEP bucket, memory_used_pct

attributes.description: The 10 VMs with the highest balloon-driver memory utilization, using the latest RAM values in the window and average swap rates. Memory percentage near 100% combined with non-zero swap-in indicates real memory pressure; a high percentage with zero swap is usually just a well-utilized cache. DRILL-DOWN ENTRY POINT: open an instance in the [GCP] GCE Instance detail dashboard to investigate it.

query.esql:
TS metrics-googlecloudmonitoringreceiver.otel-default
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gce_instance"
| STATS ram_used = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`compute.googleapis.com/instance/memory/balloon/ram_used`)), ram_size = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`compute.googleapis.com/instance/memory/balloon/ram_size`)), swap_in_bps = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(`compute.googleapis.com/instance/memory/balloon/swap_in_bytes_count`)) / 60, swap_out_bps = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(`compute.googleapis.com/instance/memory/balloon/swap_out_bytes_count`)) / 60 BY attributes.instance_name, resource.attributes.zone
| EVAL mem_used_pct = 100.0 * ram_used / ram_size
| EVAL `Mem % color` = CASE(
    mem_used_pct < 50, "#e8f7f0",
    mem_used_pct < 70, "#aee8d2",
    mem_used_pct < 85, "#fff3c2",
    mem_used_pct < 95, "#ffc9c2",
    "#f4a79e"
  )
| SORT mem_used_pct DESC
| LIMIT 10

TS metrics-googlecloudmonitoringreceiver.otel-default
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend) AND resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "gce_instance"
| STATS ram_used = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`compute.googleapis.com/instance/memory/balloon/ram_used`)), ram_size = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`compute.googleapis.com/instance/memory/balloon/ram_size`)), swap_in_bps = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(`compute.googleapis.com/instance/memory/balloon/swap_in_bytes_count`)) / 60, swap_out_bps = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(`compute.googleapis.com/instance/memory/balloon/swap_out_bytes_count`)) / 60 BY attributes.instance_name, resource.attributes.zone
| EVAL mem_used_pct = 100.0 * ram_used / ram_size
| EVAL `Mem % color` = CASE(
    mem_used_pct < 50, "#e8f7f0",
    mem_used_pct < 70, "#aee8d2",
    mem_used_pct < 85, "#fff3c2",
    mem_used_pct < 95, "#ffc9c2",
    "#f4a79e"
  )
| SORT mem_used_pct DESC
